rounds.summary: The housing and carrier board remain unchanged, while the ESP32-WROOM module is currently positioned too low at the bottom of the enclosure, intersecting the housing floor and failing the 2 mm enclosure clearance requirement. A repair transaction repositions the ESP32-WROOM module inside the housing above the left side of the carrier board with more than 2 mm clearance to the floor and all walls.

observations.detail: The ESP32-WROOM module is positioned at Y = 0.3 mm underneath the carrier board, where its lower half intersects the housing floor solid (Y = -2 to 0 mm) and is occluded in the rendered views.
Measured check design-1 fails because the ESP32-WROOM module has a -1.25 mm minimum envelope-to-interior margin against the housing floor instead of the required 2 mm clearance.
The housing preserves its original five-wall geometry and placement at [0, 0, 0], confirmed by measured check design-3.
The carrier board remains unchanged in both geometry ([54, 1.6, 32] mm) and placement ([0, 3, 0]), confirmed by measured check design-3 and visible in the top view.
